plain: A person who stirs up trouble or rebellion.

webster.text: One who foments; one who encourages or instigates; as a fomenter of sedition.

example.quote: But certain it is. that some of the principal fomenters of this plan have never shewn themselves capable of that generous system of policy which is founded in the affections of freemen.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
